annotations.title: This month's journey charges: by journey and model, against the team's monthly budget

description: Wraps GET /api/usage. This month's journey charges: by journey and model, against the team's monthly budget. Call this to see what the team's journeys have been charged this calendar month (UTC), and how much of its budget is left. Journeys are billed by use: each run at model cost plus 50%, at least $0.02. Runs stop at the budget until the 1st, or until it's raised on Billing.
name: usage

budgetUsd.description: the team's monthly journey budget, US dollars; null when it has none (a team we don't bill)

chargedUsd.description: charged so far this month, US dollars

creditUsd.description: the team's prepaid journey credit left, US dollars; null for a team we don't bill

journeysRun.description: whether the team's saved journeys run (a card on file, prepaid credit left, or a team we don't bill)

lines.description: the month's charges grouped by site, journey, kind and model, largest first

chargedUsd.description: what they were charged, US dollars

journey.description: the journey's slug; null for a try of an unsaved journey

kind.description: journey_run: a saved journey's run; journey_try: a try

runs.description: runs (a free try or a run the model's provider failed counts at $0)

price.description: how a run is charged, in words

next_steps.description: calls that usually come next, each naming its tool

tool.description: the tool that makes this call
